speaker: Mma Kagiso
english: I woke up well. How are you?

speaker: Rra Tau
english: Hello, madam. How did you wake up?

speaker: Neo
setswana: Ke tsogile sentle, ke a leboga. Wena?
english: I woke up well, thank you. And you?

speaker: Rra Tau
setswana: Ke teng. Leina la me ke Tau. Leina la gago ke mang?
english: I'm fine. My name is Tau. What is your name?

speaker: Neo
setswana: Leina la me ke Neo. O tswa kae rra?
english: My name is Neo. Where are you from sir?

speaker: Rra Tau
setswana: Ke tswa kwa Molepolole. Wena o tswa kae?
english: I come from Molepolole. Where are you from?

speaker: Neo
setswana: Ke tswa kwa Gaborone. O bua eng?
english: I come from Gaborone. What do you speak?

speaker: Neo
setswana: Ke bua Sekgoa fela. Ga ke tlhaloganye Setswana. Bua ka bonya tswee-tswee.
english: I speak English only. I don't understand Setswana. Speak slowly, please.

speaker: Bontle
english: Hello, Lesedi. How did you wake up?

speaker: Lesedi
setswana: Ke tsogile sentle, ke a leboga. Leba! Yo ke lelapa la me.
english: I woke up well, thank you. Look! This is my family.

speaker: Lesedi
setswana: Yo ke rre. Yo ke kgaitsadi wa me.
english: This is my father. This is my sister.

speaker: Bontle
setswana: Mosetsana yo ke ngwana wa gago?

speaker: Lesedi
setswana: Ee ke ngwana wa me. Bana ba me ke mosetsana le mosimane.
english: Yes, she is my child. My children are a girl and a boy.

speaker: Mma Kefilwe
english: Hello sir. What do you want?

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Dumela, mma. Ke lapile. Ke batla nama le bogobe.
english: Hello, madam. I'm hungry. I want meat and porridge.

speaker: Mma Kefilwe
setswana: O nwa eng? Tee kgotsa kofi?
english: What do you drink? Tea or coffee?

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Ga ke nwe tee kgotsa kofi. Metsi tswee-tswee.
english: I don't drink tea or coffee. Water, please.

speaker: Tumelo
setswana: Ga ke batle maungo ke a leboga.
english: I don't want fruit, thank you.
